blocks.instruction: Leia o texto e escolha a alternativa correta. Algumas perguntas pedem inferência — a resposta não está escrita com todas as letras.
blocks.passage:
A short, kind email opens many doors. At Czarnikow we write many emails every day.

A good email has three parts. First, a friendly opening, like "Dear" or "Hi". Then a clear message. Last, a polite close, like "Best regards" or "Thanks".

Keep it short, warm and professional. Take your time. Every sentence counts.

items.q: How many parts does a good email have?
items.why: "A good email has three parts" — abertura, mensagem e despedida.

items.q: Which word is a friendly opening?
items.why: "a friendly opening, like Dear or Hi".

items.q: Which word is a polite close?
items.why: "a polite close, like Best regards or Thanks".

items.q: The text says "every sentence counts". This suggests that…
options: each sentence in a short email matters
items.why: Inferência: como o email é curto, cada frase tem peso e deve ser bem escolhida.

items.q: The author would most likely AGREE that a good email is…
items.why: Inferência: o texto pede "short, warm and professional".

blocks.instruction: Ouça James falando devagar sobre emails no dia a dia da Czarnikow. Responda sem ler a transcrição — ela só aparece depois de corrigir.

audio.text:
Hi, everyone. Today I want to talk about emails.

At Czarnikow, I write many emails every morning. I like to start with a friendly word. I write "Hi Ana" or "Dear Mr. Smith". A warm opening is nice.

Then I write my message. I keep it short and clear. One idea, two ideas — not too much. If the message is long, people do not read it.

I always close with a polite word. I write "Best regards" or "Thanks". Then I write my name.

When I get an email, I try to reply on the same day. A fast reply makes people happy. If I am busy, I still write two lines: "Thanks for your email. I will reply soon."

One more thing. I always check the subject line. A clear subject helps people find my message later. Short and simple — that is my rule.
audio.label: Ouça quantas vezes precisar. A transcrição aparece depois de corrigir.

items.q: How does James like to start his emails?
items.why: "I like to start with a friendly word. I write Hi Ana or Dear Mr. Smith."

items.q: What does James do with his message?
options: He keeps it short and clear
He does not write a message
items.why: "I keep it short and clear."

items.q: When does James try to reply?
items.why: "I try to reply on the same day."

items.q: Why does James write "I will reply soon" when he is busy?
options: Because he does not want to answer
So the person knows an answer is coming
Because it is a rule at Czarnikow
So he can close the email
items.why: Inferência: mesmo ocupado, ele avisa que a resposta virá, para não deixar a pessoa sem retorno.

items.q: Why does James check the subject line?
options: Because it is required by law
So people can find the message later
items.why: Inferência: "A clear subject helps people find my message later."

blocks.instruction: O vocabulário da lição aparece aqui em frases novas. Escolha o sentido ou a palavra que cabe no contexto.

items.q: "I send you an email every morning." An email is…
options: a message you write on a computer or phone
items.why: Email = mensagem escrita e enviada online.

items.q: "Your message is very clear, thank you." A message is…
options: the words you send to someone
items.why: Message = mensagem, o que você comunica.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "I read your email and I will send a ___ soon."
items.why: Reply = resposta a um email recebido.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "The email ___ is 'Meeting on Monday'."
items.why: Subject = assunto, o título curto do email.

items.q: "Best regards, James." Regards is…
options: a polite way to close an email
a way to open an email
items.why: Regards = atenciosamente, usado para se despedir.

blocks.instruction: Expressões simples que aparecem em emails de trabalho. Escolha o sentido no contexto.

items.q: "I hope you are well." We use I hope you are well to…
options: open an email in a kind way
items.why: "I hope you are well" é uma abertura gentil de email.

items.q: "Please find the report attached." This means the report is…
items.why: Attached = anexado, enviado junto com o email.

items.q: "Let me know if you have questions." Let me know means…
items.why: Let me know = me avise, me diga.

items.q: "I will get back to you tomorrow." This means I will…
items.why: Get back to you = te dar um retorno/responder depois.

items.q: "Thanks for your email. Have a nice day." Have a nice day is used to…
options: end an email in a friendly way
items.why: "Have a nice day" é uma despedida simpática.
